expectations.buyer: Gamete tissue establishments, fertility networks, competent authorities, donor-conceived family support and recall coordinators
expectations.pain: A donor exceeds family limits across institutions or a later genetic safety signal cannot be traced and communicated quickly across jurisdictions
expectations.strongestIncumbent: National donor registries, clinic donor-management systems, coding under EU SoHO rules, HFEA-style authority registers, manual bilateral notices, and identity-release processes
expectations.biggestRisk: Member States and competent authorities may own the registry control plane, legal bases and identifiers may not permit cross-border linkage, and the network cannot launch without simultaneous institutional participation
